pari.cp: a prefix denoting completion. all round; altogether; completely.

C: pari：[a prefix denoting completion] all round； altogether； completely．
I: pari：Around，about．Generally used in composition with verbs and their derivatives．
U: PARI：（tiếp đầu ngữ có nghĩa trọn vẹn，hoàn toàn），tất cả chung quanh，trọn cả，hoàn toàn，trọn vẹn
R:
pari：ပရိ （ဥ）
ထက်ဝန်းကျင်မှ ဖြစ်ခြင်း။ စုံလင်ခြင်း။ လုံးဝဖြစ်ခြင်း။ လွန်စွာ ဖြစ်ခြင်း။ စသောအနက်တို့၌ ဖြစ်သော ဥပသာရပုဒ်။
DOP: pari [ ts ], prefix to nouns, adjectives, adverbs; preverb to verbs; before vowels pariy-, payir-; Abh 1175 (samantatthe paricchede pūjāliṅganavajjane dosakkhāne nivāsanāvañññādhāresu bhojane sokavyāpanatatvesu lakkhaṇādo siyā pari); Sadd 882, 4* foll.; — expressing : 1. around, round about; all round, completely, fully; Paṭis I 176, 29 (~ī ti pariggahaṭṭho mukhan ti niyyānaṭṭho satī ti upaṭṭhānaṭṭho tena vuccati parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā ti) quoted Vism 271, 17 ; Spk II 59, 30 (~ī ti upasaggaṃ pakkhipitvā); Ap-a 422, 2 (parinibbute bhagavatī ti ~i samantato kiñci anavasesetvā khandhaparinibbānakāle); Paṭis-a 35, 29 (vyāpanaṭṭhena °-saddena); — 2. off, away from (+ abl.); Sadd 702, 17 ; — 3. to the share of; successively; except; Sadd 715, 25 ; 777, 31 foll.; — see also pali.
